test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Companies will go after one other in their marketing campaigns.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part of the given sentence that has an error in it is: **'After one other in'.**
 
• The phrase** "after one other"** is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"after each other"** or **"after one another".**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"Companies will go after each other in their marketing campaigns."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are not the correct answer:
 
 
• **'Their marketing campaigns.' **- This part of the sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• **'Companies will go' **- This part of the sentence is also grammatically correct.
